name: welfare-awareness-gap-miner
description: Government Welfare Scheme Awareness Gap Miner — collection, NLP and analytics platform

scripts.setup: node scripts/run-python.js -m pip install -r requirements.txt && npm --prefix frontend install && npm run db:migrate && npm run seed
scripts.dev: npm run db:migrate && concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "UI,API,WRK" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.test:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run build
